body:
My main issue with "htmlAttributes" is that as a user POV it's giving the idea that they could manage everything, from the attributes to the dom tagName and the dom elements which is not the case.

While only providing them to add classes and giving them pre-computed ids seems more narrow and closes the API for now.

Until we get the need (use case) or find a complete react compatible (dom diff compatible) templating solution I would not got this way.
